Questions, answered

Contact FAQs

How quickly can you come out?
We inspect 6 days a week across Greater Sydney. For an active leak, call us and we'll find you the earliest available time.
What should I have ready?
A rough idea of where the water is showing up, how long it's been happening, and a photo or two if you can. It helps us bring the right equipment.
Do you cover my suburb?
We service all of Greater Sydney, from the Inner West and Eastern Suburbs to the Northern Beaches, North Shore, Hills, Sutherland Shire and west. Ask when you book.
